name: Orange Circle Antique Mall
tagline: Orange County’s premier two-story antique destination with over 100 dealers
description: Housed in an immense 1912 commercial building on South Glassell, the Orange Circle Antique Mall is an antique enthusiast’s wonderland. Featuring two sweeping levels and over a hundred curated vendor showcases with Victorian jewelry, mid-century modern furniture, vintage toys, retro neon signs, art deco pottery, and rare California citrus memorabilia.
historicNote: Originally built in 1912 as the Knox Brothers Department Store, preserving the original hardwood plank floors, historic freight elevator, and pressed tin ceiling tiles.

specials.title: Midweek Treasure Hunter 15% Off
specials.description: Participating vendor booths offer 10% to 15% off vintage glassware, ceramics, and retro estate jewelry.

specials.title: Friday Vinyl & Retro Showcase
specials.description: Free protective vinyl sleeves with every 3 vintage LP records purchased from the 2nd-floor music booths.

specials.title: Weekend Appraisal Table
specials.description: Free verbal appraisal on up to 2 vintage collectibles or heirlooms with in-house certified appraisers.

specials.title: Sunday Collector Spotlight
specials.description: Featured dealer showcases rotate with special tags and discounts up to 20% on selected showcases.

events.title: Old Towne Vintage Appraisal & Discovery Day
events.description: Meet guest vintage restorers and historians as they demonstrate pocket watch repair and antique jewelry care.
events.location: Orange Circle Antique Mall 2nd Floor Gallery
